title: Index options · Technical Design Document
purpose: What do, or did we do, with the time available in our data?
date_convention: All windows [start,end_exclusive). Null endpoints mean no assigned dates; B1 has an empty evidence set.

coverage.note: Declared protocol horizon through calendar 2026, not a claim of observed data through 2026-12-31. Protected rows were not inspected.

presentation.single_registry: windows drives both the table and the number line; identical active filter; null-date rows remain listed without invented coordinates.
presentation.detail: Endpoint dots mark exact nominal boundaries; observed support and label purges remain in table details.

decisions: A0008's current Path recipe is TCN, chain arm, seed 11, one model alone. M51 uses wide_mlp64 in its saved model slot; that recorded dependency does not change Path.
2019 warm-up is never ranked as predictive validation. User-requested 2019 MIO pair selection is a separate, still unspecified operation.
2020 is already exposed for MIO development. Predictive selection used 2020-23, so future MIO-only comparisons there are not untouched full-system tests.
The draft MIO JSON interfaces remain design-only. Their suggested dates and example variants are not decisions in this document.
2024-25 is the lane's separately opened holdout; 2026 is permanently sealed. No new fitting, scoring or replay was done to write this TDD.

symbols.symbol: i = (sᵢ, tᵢ, eᵢ, τᵢ, xᵢ, zᵢ)
symbols.definition: One predictive observation is (ticker, quote date, expiry), with settlement τ, features x known at origin t, and outcome z = log(terminal_price/spot)/reference_scale. The saved panel fixes the scale and feature definitions.

All displayed intervals are half-open ISO calendar dates. Source fold ends and observed maximum dates are inclusive and are converted by adding one day. A band spans possible dates, not continuous observations.

symbols.symbol: D(I; S) = {i ∈ Ω : tᵢ ∈ I ∧ sᵢ ∈ S}; E(c) = {i : τᵢ < c}
symbols.definition: Ω is the pinned prepared panel, with quote and settlement strictly before 2024-01-01. S₀ is the ticker list in the pinned recipe. Earlier-side membership always requires settlement strictly before its boundary.

Counts use the fold bands before admission. The configured minimum disjoint-label count is zero. Exact retained memberships are stored in each R-model-f run; both current dependency lanes have the same memberships. This is predictive sample admission, not the undecided 2019 MIO gate.

symbols.symbol: c_f = first(last₈₂({t ∈ calendar(Ω|S₀) : a_f ≤ t < b_f}))
symbols.definition: a_f and b_f are the training-window endpoints. c_f is the first of the last 82 distinct observed quote dates in that window, not 82 calendar days. b_f is inclusive train_end + one day.

symbols.symbol: T_f = D([a_f,c_f); S_f) ∩ E(c_f); C_f = D([c_f,b_f); S_f) ∩ E(v_f)
symbols.definition: T is optimization fit data. C is the early-stop monitor, named cal in saved files. v_f is first validation quote date. Label purging can leave a gap before either seam.
w_f is inclusive val_end + one day. f=1 is warm-up only. f=2…5 are scored. Scored validation labels may settle in the next year; later learning admits them only after settlement.

T = Path TCN, M = wide_mlp64 dependency of the recorded M51 run. Each λ is the fixed saved settings object, including seed 11, epochs ≤150 and patience 50. These are two roles, not an approved model tournament or HPO grid.

symbols.symbol: θ̂, F̂, Q̂, ŵ; e*; P₁₉*, m*
symbols.definition: Hats denote estimated parameters, forecasts, quantiles or numerically fitted weights. e* is the selected visited checkpoint. P₁₉* and m* denote intended selected pairs and final recipe; neither has been chosen here. No global optimizer guarantee is implied for MIO.

symbols.symbol: p = (s,[d⁻,d⁺]) ∈ S × N², 1 ≤ d⁻ ≤ d⁺; d(q)=expiry(q)−signal_date(q)
symbols.definition: A pair means one ticker plus an exact DTE (d⁻=d⁺) or inclusive DTE band, measured in calendar days at the signal date. P is a sparse set of these pairs; never a Cartesian expansion. Predictive expiry-rank cells (A0006) are a separate axis.

symbols.symbol: q, A_t(P), η_m, x̂_t, B_t, L_m
symbols.definition: q is an option contract quote; A_t is the admitted quote set. η_m is a frozen MIO formulation/parameter set, x̂_t its returned integer contract vector, B_t account capital in USD, and L_m its replay ledger. Contracts use the multiplier and fees in pinned params.

functions.formula: Ω = Prepare_JSON(Q_chain, B_daily); xᵢ = Features_{≤tᵢ}(Q_chain, B_daily)
functions.meaning: Build exact-expiry tables and then the panel. 2016 is lag/RV and first-seen history; emitted model observations start 2017-01-03. Preparation does not fit a predictive model.

functions.formula: θ̂_{f,e}ᵐ = Train_{λ_fᵐ}(T_f, e); ℓ_λ = CRPS + tail_CRPS
functions.meaning: Optimization visits epochs using the fixed config. The tail objective integrates the configured intervals [-2.5,-0.5] and [0.5,2.5]; it is distinct from the reporting grid score. Feature scaling/imputation is fitted on T_f only.

functions.formula: e_f* = first argmin_{e ∈ visited epochs} |C_f|⁻¹ Σ_{i∈C_f} ℓ_λ(F̂_{f,e}(·|xᵢ),zᵢ); F̂_f = F_{θ̂_{f,e_f*}}
functions.meaning: Monitor the same configured training objective, patience 50, restore the best visited checkpoint. This selects an epoch; no current HPO search window or λ* is recorded.

M51 grid score: Z={-3,-2.5,…,3}; w=1 at |z|=0.5…2.5 and 0.25 at z=0,±3. Report A0002 primary twCRPS plus full CRPS, strike Brier/reliability and PIT/tail diagnostics under their registered implementations. Grid13 is an approximation, not the full-distribution integral.
2019 warm-up is never ranked. Report full validation and each year/regime; strike regions are decompositions, not an evaluation subset selected by outcomes.

functions.formula: Ĝ_f = PITMap₂₁({F_market,i(zᵢ): i∈T_f ∩ eligible_M51}); F̂_market_cal,i = Ĝ_f ∘ F_market,i
functions.meaning: The recorded M51 pipeline fits its market PIT map from the current fold's fit band, using its pinned component eligibility/finite-value filters.

functions.formula: L_f = (⋃_{g<f} V_g) ∩ E(v_f) ∩ eligible_M51; ŵ_{f,b} = FitQA_JSON(L_f ∩ bucket_b); Q̂_f(u)=Σ_j ŵ_{f,b,j} Q̂_{f,j}(u)
functions.meaning: j∈{model,market_cal,pooled,baseline}; nonnegative simplex weights, 199 quantile levels, dispersion buckets in JSON, min_rows=5000 and learning cap=100000. Invert averaged quantiles to a CDF. f=1 and insufficient buckets fall back to the MLP component, with fitted=false. FitQA is the numerical algorithm, not a claim of global minimization.

functions.formula: Eligible(m) ⇔ Skill_A0002(m,r;V₂:₅)>0 for both r AND count_y[Skill(m,r;V_y)>0 for both r]≥3
functions.meaning: Path A0005 compares horizon_empirical and raw market on paired evidence, with two-way expiry/symbol cluster intervals; never choose the best cell. A0004 promotion seeds are {11,29,47}; A0008's current run is seed 11 alone. Final promotion execution and recipe remain undecided.

functions.formula: Pass(c) ⇔ Σ_y 1{J(m,c,y)<J(raw,c,y) ∧ J(m,c,y)<J(name,c,y)}≥3 AND Σ_r 1{same paired inequalities in regime r}≥3
functions.meaning: c=(ticker,expiry rank) from A0006. Path A0007: at least 3/4 years and 3/5 regimes; report pass count beside chance expectation, no multiplicity correction yet. Not the 2019 MIO pair-admission rule.

User decision: only ticker/DTE pairs doing well in 2019 enter MIO testing. g₁₉, scoring definition, exact periods and selected members are undecided; 2019 is the enclosing selection year. No criterion is invented here.

functions.formula: A_t(P)={q : ∃(s,[d⁻,d⁺])∈P, symbol(q)=s ∧ d⁻≤d(q)≤d⁺ ∧ eligible_JSON(q,t)}; x̂_tᵐ = Solve_{η_m}(F̂_t,A_t(P),B_t)
functions.meaning: Eligibility, constraints and objective come from the resolved run params. Returned incumbent is not labeled x* without an optimality certificate. Future sparse-pair adapter and exact formulation set are not implemented by the design templates.

For future packets, history, entry and settlement windows must be separately specified and pinned. Each packet comparison uses the same admitted pairs and frozen variants. Exact packet dates, η set and promotion criterion remain undecided.

functions.formula: Read(I)=∅; Fit(I)=∅; Select(I)=∅; Report(I)=∅ while sealed
functions.meaning: 2024-25 is a separately authorized single-opening holdout for promoted recipes. 2026 stays closed permanently. This records policy for this lane; it does not assert nobody ever inspected those years in any other project.

population.fit_membership: Exact symbols per model/fold are in runs[].symbols; count-based predictive admission only.
